title: Vehicle Acceptance Limits of the Keyturn Host Protection Plan
content:
Which vehicles a plan of the Keyturn Host Protection Plan will write cover on is settled by the plan's published limits on age, odometer, value, title and territory, together with its published inspection requirements.

### Age, odometer and value

| Plan | Oldest vehicle, whole years from the model year | Highest odometer, miles | Lowest value, USD | Highest value, USD |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan | 14 | 150000 | 4000 | 45000 |
| Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | 13 | 140000 | 5000 | 70000 |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | 12 | 130000 | 6000 | 100000 |
| Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | 10 | 120000 | 8000 | 150000 |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | 8 | 100000 | 12000 | 200000 |
| Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan | 6 | 80000 | 20000 | 300000 |

### Title, territory and inspection

| Plan | Title statuses written | Territories written | Passed inspection before cover begins | Inspection every year |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan | clean title, financed by a lienholder | the US mainland | no | no |
| Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | clean title, financed by a lienholder | the US mainland, Canada | no | no |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | clean title, financed by a lienholder, leased | the US mainland, Canada | yes | yes |
| Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | clean title, financed by a lienholder, leased | the US mainland, Canada, Alaska and Hawaii | yes | yes |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | clean title, financed by a lienholder, leased | the US mainland, Canada, Alaska and Hawaii | yes | yes |
| Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan | clean title, financed by a lienholder, leased | the US mainland, Canada, Alaska and Hawaii | yes | yes |

### Notes on the bands

The value band narrows at the bottom and widens at the top as cover deepens: the Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan writes vehicles valued between 4000 and 45000, the Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan between 20000 and 300000. A leased title is written only from the Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan downward, and Alaska and Hawaii only from the Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan downward. The Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan and every plan below it require both a passed inspection before cover begins and an inspection every year; the Keyturn Shield 90 and Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plans require neither.
